title: Read and run Analysis Operations with op_change
summary: Use an explicit operation range. op:=get reads the operation tree and op:=run recalculates it. This plugin tracks only operations it created.

title: Structured X-Function execution
summary: Prefer allowlisted parameters and typed range, output, file, and scalar values. Unverified X-Functions require explicit opt-in.

title: Origin Data Connectors
summary: Create, inspect, refresh, and disconnect CSV or Excel connectors while preserving an explicit keep-data policy.

title: Matrix books and sheets
summary: Matrix data uses stable matrix-sheet references and rectangular finite blocks. Readback is required after writes.

title: Graph templates
summary: Discover templates beneath explicit roots and apply only a selected .otp or .otpu whose SHA-256 still matches.

title: Origin plot types
summary: Select graph types by exact required data roles. Matrix plots and worksheet plots are not interchangeable.

title: Project Explorer folders
summary: Use full project paths and never recursively delete a non-empty folder without explicit confirmation.

title: Digest-bound FigureSpec workflows
summary: Plan once, bind the exact specification digest, execute serial stages, and stop at the first failure.
